001package dayplanner;
002
003
004
005/**
006 * <p>
007 * This class contains methods that parse and write RAS (Readable Activity
008 * Serial) activity records. RAS is the custom text format that allows data to
009 * be persisted to disk.
010 * </p>
011 * <p>
012 * All methods of this class are static, so it is not necessary to instantiate
013 * this class.
014 * </p>
015 * <p>
016 * RAS records are comma-delimited and wrapped in angle brackets. Commas in
017 * field values are not escaped. Commas and angle brackets are
018 * sanitized/desanitized so they can be used in Activity fields.
019 * </p>
020 * <p>
021 * For the full RAS specification, read the <code>README.md</code>
022 * documentation.
023 * </p>
024 */
025public final class RasParser {
026    /**
027     * Default constructor. Not used.
028     */
029    private RasParser() {}
030
031
032
033    /**
034     * <p>
035     * Parses one RAS record and creates its corresponding activity.
036     * </p>
037     * <p>
038     * Unknown type names produce a plain {@link Activity}, preserving the
039     * format's existing fallback behavior.
040     * </p>
041     *
042     * @param ras Serialized activity record.
043     * @return The activity represented by the record.
044     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
045     */
046    public static Activity parse(String ras)
047    throws RasException {
048        // extract fields
049        String[] fields = fields(ras);
050        boolean other = fields[0].equals("OtherActivity");
051        if (!other && !fields[0].equals("HomeActivity") && !fields[0].equals("SchoolActivity"))
052            throw new RasException("unknown activity type: " + fields[0]);
053        if (fields.length != (other ? 6 : 5))
054            throw new RasException("expected " + (other ? 6 : 5) + " fields but found " + fields.length);
055        if (fields[1].isBlank())
056            throw new RasException("title is empty");
057
058        Time sTime = Input.parseTime(desanitize(fields[2]));
059        Time eTime = Input.parseTime(desanitize(fields[3]));
060        if (sTime == null || eTime == null)
061            throw new RasException("invalid start or end time");
062        if (sTime.compareTo(eTime) >= 0)
063            throw new RasException("start is not before end");
064
065        String title = desanitize(fields[1]);
066        String comment = optional(fields, 4);
067
068        // instantiate the appropriate class
069        return switch (fields[0]) {
070            case "HomeActivity"
071                -> new HomeActivity(title, sTime, eTime, comment);
072            case "SchoolActivity"
073                -> new SchoolActivity(title, sTime, eTime, comment);
074            default -> {
075                if (fields[5].isBlank())
076                    throw new RasException("location is empty");
077                yield new OtherActivity(title, sTime, eTime, comment, desanitize(fields[5]));
078            }
079        };
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * Writes one activity as a RAS record.
084     *
085     * @param activity Activity to serialize.
086     * @return Its RAS representation.
087     */
088    public static String serialize(Activity activity) {
089        // define fields
090        String type = activity.getClass().getSimpleName();
091        String title = activity.getTitle();
092        String sTime = activity.getStartTime().toString();
093        String eTime = activity.getEndTime().toString();
094        String comment = activity.getComment();
095
096        // sanitize all fields
097        type = sanitize(type);
098        title = sanitize(title);
099        sTime = sanitize(sTime);
100        eTime = sanitize(eTime);
101        comment = sanitize(comment);
102
103        String ras = String.format(
104            "%s,%s,%s,%s,%s",
105            type, title, sTime, eTime,
106            (comment == null || comment.isBlank() ? "NIL" : comment));
107        
108        // add location field for Other Activities
109        if (activity instanceof OtherActivity other) {
110            String location = sanitize(other.getLocation());
111            ras += "," + (location == null ? "NIL" : location);
112        }
113        
114        // wrap in angled brackets
115        return "<" + ras + ">";
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * Returns the fields inside one RAS record. Missing fields are retained as
120     * empty strings so the activity class can apply its existing defaults.
121     *
122     * @param ras Serialized activity record.
123     * @return The record fields, including the activity type at index zero.
124     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
125     */
126    public static String[] fields(String ras)
127    throws RasException {
128        if (ras == null || !ras.startsWith("<") || !ras.endsWith(">") || ras.length() < 2)
129            throw new RasException("record must be wrapped in < >");
130        String inner = ras.substring(1, ras.length() - 1);
131        return inner.split(",", -1);
132    }
133
134    /**
135     * Populate the fields of this Activity in accordance with the given RAS string.
136     * 
137     * @param activity The activity whose fields to populate.
138     * @param ras      Serialized activity record.
139     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
140     */
141    public static void populate(Activity activity, String ras)
142    throws RasException {
143        String[] f = fields(ras);
144        boolean other = f[0].equals("OtherActivity");
145        if (!other && !f[0].equals("HomeActivity") && !f[0].equals("SchoolActivity"))
146            throw new RasException("unknown activity type: " + f[0]);
147        if (f.length != (other ? 6 : 5))
148            throw new RasException("expected " + (other ? 6 : 5) + " fields but found " + f.length);
149        if (f[1].isBlank())
150            throw new RasException("title is empty");
151
152        Time start = Input.parseTime(desanitize(f[2]));
153        Time end = Input.parseTime(desanitize(f[3]));
154        if (start == null || end == null)
155            throw new RasException("invalid start or end time");
156        if (start.compareTo(end) >= 0)
157            throw new RasException("start is not before end");
158
159        String comment = optional(f, 4);
160
161        if (activity != null) {
162            activity.setTitle(desanitize(f[1]));
163            activity.setStartTime(start);
164            activity.setEndTime(end);
165            activity.setComment(comment);
166            if (other) {
167                if (f[5].isBlank())
168                    throw new RasException("location is empty");
169                if (activity instanceof OtherActivity o)
170                    o.setLocation(desanitize(f[5]));
171            }
172        }
173    }
174
175    /**
176     * Extract the location from a RAS string.
177     * 
178     * @param ras Serialized activity record.
179     * @return Location content.
180     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
181     */
182    public static String location(String ras)
183    throws RasException {
184        String[] fields = fields(ras);
185        return fields.length >= 6 && !fields[5].isEmpty() && !fields[5].equals("NIL")
186            ? desanitize(fields[5]) : null;
187    }
188
189    /**
190     * Extract the time from a RAS string.
191     * 
192     * @param fields Array of fields.
193     * @param index  Index where the time is located.
194     * @return Time content.
195     */
196    public static Time time(String[] fields, int index) {
197        if (index >= fields.length || fields[index].isEmpty())
198            return new Time();
199        return new Time(desanitize(fields[index]));
200    }
201
202    /**
203     * Extract any required field at any index from a RAS string.
204     * 
205     * @param fields   Array of fields.
206     * @param index    Index.
207     * @param fallback Fallback value in case the value at index does not exist or
208     *                 is empty.
209     * @return Value content.
210     */
211    public static String value(String[] fields, int index, String fallback) {
212        return index < fields.length && !fields[index].isEmpty()
213            ? desanitize(fields[index])
214            : fallback;
215    }
216
217    
218    /**
219     * Extract any optional field at any index from a RAS string.
220     * 
221     * @param fields Array of fields.
222     * @param index  Index.
223     * @return Value content if it exists, null otherwise.
224     */
225    public static String optional(String[] fields, int index) {
226        if (index >= fields.length || fields[index].isEmpty()
227         || fields[index].equals("NIL"))
228            return null;
229        return desanitize(fields[index]);
230    }
231
232    /**
233     * Sanitize input for serialization using HTML codes.
234     * HTML codes referenced from <a href=
235     * "https://www.rapidtables.com/web/html/html-codes.html">RapidTables</a>.
236     * 
237     * @param input Input to sanitize.
238     * @return Sanitized input, or <code>null</code> if input is null.
239     * @see #desanitize(String)
240     */
241    public static String sanitize(String input) {
242        if (input == null)
243            return null;
244        return input
245            .replace(",", "&#44;")
246            .replace("<", "&#60;")
247            .replace(">", "&#62;");
248    }
249
250    /**
251     * Desanitize input for serialization using HTML codes.
252     * HTML codes referenced from <a href=
253     * "https://www.rapidtables.com/web/html/html-codes.html">RapidTables</a>.
254     * 
255     * @param input Input to desanitize.
256     * @return Desnitized input, or <code>null</code> if input is null.
257     * @see #sanitize(String)
258     */
259    public static String desanitize(String input) {
260        if (input == null)
261            return null;
262        return input
263            .replace("&#62;", ">")
264            .replace("&#60;", "<")
265            .replace("&#44;", ",");
266    }
267}
